reference_canvas.note: Design coordinate reference only, not device dp.

units.source_raster: physical source px; convert through page authority

layout_rules.fixed: Stable frozen slot geometry; not sticky to window unless page contract says so.
layout_rules.flexible: Hero/content can grow only when page authority allows; no image stretch.
layout_rules.scroll: Detail/dense content scrolls before factual text or action reachability is compressed.
layout_rules.adaptive: Cards/rows grow or reflow preserving semantic order; Fish Guide carousel remains page-specific.

insets.status_bar: Host owns dynamic top safe inset / cutout; resolve once.
insets.navigation_bar: Host owns bottom gesture inset; primary action remains reachable.
insets.keyboard: IME resizes usable viewport; scroll focused input and action into view, no screenshot-derived spacer.
insets.origin: Declare one window/content origin; never add safeDrawing padding and a second full-window offset.

font_scale.rule: Honor OS fontScale; allow layout growth and long-page scroll; do not silently shrink.

image_scale.general: No non-uniform scaling; preserve source bytes.
image_scale.result: State-specific Hero geometry; trusted subject-safe crop, else Safe Fit; No Fish/Image Quality Evidence Fit.
image_scale.detail: HERO_ADAPTIVE safe Fill if FishSafeRect fits; otherwise same-source Safe Fit + low-salience ambient.

historical_issues.rule: Approved NH05 whole-page offset min(E×0.36,180×S), E=max(0,(H-T-B)-1920S); one physical window origin; account insets once.
historical_issues.status: Design rule recorded; runtime anchor measurement pending.

historical_issues.rule: Keep state-specific Hero / Mist Glass geometry; content-height and scroll, no stretching to fill spare viewport.
HERO_ADAPTIVE safe Fill or Safe Fit + same-source ambient; no arbitrary crop.
historical_issues.status: Frozen design rule; device verification out of scope.

historical_issues.rule: Dynamic IME inset + resize/scroll; focused input and primary action reachable.
